Every part of your AI stays yours.

Unlike frontier models, you own your data on Uare.ai. It’s never used to train other models. Every part of your Human Learning Model stays yours.

  • Own

    You own your data.

    A private model of your knowledge, built from your own material. Delete what you share any time.

  • Control

    You decide what it shares.

    You choose which files are public and which stay private, what each connected system shares, and what your AI sends.

  • Understand

    You know exactly how it works.

    Guidance at every step shows you how to set up your Human Learning Model safely and securely.

  • Grounded

    It answers from what you know.

    When a question falls outside your expertise, your AI says so and points the client to you.

  • Private

    Stored privately.

    Your data is yours alone, stored privately and securely. You choose what is public, Subscriber-only or private.

  • Portable

    Take it with you.

    Your data is yours to export on request. Delete it anytime, and we remove it from active systems and purge it from backups on our retention cycle.

    Questions, answered.

    Will it work with the tools I already use?

    Yes. Your AI works inside your email, calendar, files and client tools. You choose what each one shares and approve what it sends.

    Where do its answers come from?

    From your own knowledge: the documents, recordings, lessons and Thoughts you add, and the way you explain things.

    Can I see what it tells my clients?

    Yes. You see every chat, you approve what it knows, and you can correct any answer.

    Who owns my Human Learning Model?

    You do. It is a private model of your knowledge, built from your own material, and you decide which files are public and which stay private.

    Can you build it with us?

    Yes. Setup with our team is included with Professional, and Organizations are set up with our team from the start.
